recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7634 unless a future human cleanup separately adjusts non-normative historical committee-note tags.
issue_request: FHIR-7634 asked to reconcile Procedure.notes and ProcedureRequest.notes after Procedure was 0..1 while ProcedureRequest was 0..*. The final resolution was to adopt the MnM agreement of 0..* Annotation.
initial_application: Historical commit 2541d8119c applied the issue by changing Procedure.notes from 0..1 string to 0..* Annotation and by changing ProcedureRequest.notes from string to Annotation while preserving its 0..* cardinality.
additional_context: Procedure and ServiceRequest are active current resources in source/fhir.ini. ProcedureRequest is recorded there as merged into ServiceRequest, and later git history renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest. FHIR-7633 independently confirms the same notes 0..* Annotation alignment, and FHIR-10293 later renamed notes to note without changing the datatype or cardinality.
reconciliation: No source change was made because Procedure.note and ServiceRequest.note already have min 0, max *, and type Annotation in the current build source. Editing retired ProcedureRequest source would be out of current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Procedure/ProcedureRequest alignment issue whose resolution also says notes should be 0..* Annotation in both resources.
Later Patient Care workflow standardization renamed Procedure.notes and ProcedureRequest.notes to note while retaining the 0..* Annotation semantics.
